title: Zephyrine and the Deadline
author: Paloma Galloway
blurb: Hazel Reyes, a fixer for an embassy that doesn't officially exist, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. Then the safe house is listed for sale — with photos of the inside — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must burn the network that did the training, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
